vsm2.17:120.2:
(1) Kinds of Mundane Resultant Consciousness

120. In the clause, with formations as condition, consciousness, consciousness is sixfold as eye-consciousness, and so on.
vsm2.17:120.3:
Herein, eye-consciousness is twofold, namely, profitable kamma-resultant and unprofitable
kamma-resultant (see Table II for bracketed numbers that follow).
vsm2.17:120.4: Likewise ear-, nose-, tongue-, and body-consciousness ((34)–(38) and (50)–(54)).
vsm2.17:120.5:
But mind-consciousness is twenty-two-fold, namely, the two profitable and unprofitable resultant mind elements
((39) and (55)), the three root-causeless mind-consciousness elements ((40), (41) and (56)),
vsm2.17:120.6:
the eight sense-sphere resultant consciousnesses with root-cause ((42)–(49)), the five of the fine-material
sphere ((57)–(61)), and the four of the immaterial sphere ((62)–(65)).
vsm2.17:120.7: So all the thirty-two mundane resultant consciousnesses ((34)–(65)) are included by these six kinds of consciousness.
vsm2.17:120.8: But the supramundane kinds do not belong to the exposition of the round of becoming, and so they are not included.
vsm2.17:121.1:
121. Here it may be asked: “But how is it to be known that this consciousness of the kind
stated actually has formations as its condition?”
vsm2.17:121.2: —Because there is no kamma-result when there is no stored-up kamma.
vsm2.17:121.3: For this consciousness is kamma-result, and kamma-result does not arise in the absence of stored-up kamma.
vsm2.17:121.4: If it did, then all kinds of kamma-resultant consciousnesses would arise in all kinds of beings, and they do not do so.
vsm2.17:121.5: This is how it should be known that such consciousness has formations as its condition.
vsm2.17:122.1: 122. But which kind of consciousness has which kind of formations as its condition?
vsm2.17:122.2:
Firstly, the following sixteen kinds arise with the sense-sphere formation of merit as condition:
the five profitable resultants beginning with eye-consciousness ((34)–(38)), and in the case of mind-consciousness
one kind of mind element (39) and two kinds of mind-consciousness element ((40)–(41)),
vsm2.17:122.3: and the eight kinds of sense-sphere resultant ((42)–(49)).
vsm2.17:122.4:
according as it is said: “Owing to profitable kamma of the sense sphere having been performed,
stored up, resultant eye-consciousness” (Dhs §431),
vsm2.17:122.5: “ear-, nose-, tongue-, body-consciousness” (Dhs §443), “resultant mind element arises” (Dhs §455),
vsm2.17:122.6:
“mind-consciousness element accompanied by joy arises” (Dhs §469), “mind-consciousness
element accompanied by equanimity arises” (Dhs §484),
vsm2.17:122.7:
“accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge … accompanied by joy, associated with knowledge and prompted …
accompanied by joy and dissociated from knowledge … accompanied by joy, dissociated from knowledge and prompted …
vsm2.17:122.8:
accompanied by equanimity and associated with knowledge … accompanied by equanimity,
associated with knowledge and prompted … accompanied by equanimity and dissociated from knowledge …
accompanied by equanimity, dissociated from knowledge and prompted” (Dhs §498).
vsm2.17:123.1:
123. There are five kinds of resultant fine-material-sphere consciousness ((57)–
(61)) with the fine-material-sphere formation of merit as condition,
vsm2.17:123.2:
according as it is said: “Owing to that same profitable kamma of the fine-material sphere having been performed,
stored up, by the development of that same profitable jhāna, secluded from sense desires … he
enters upon and dwells in the resultant first jhāna … fifth jhāna” (Dhs §499).
vsm2.17:124.1:
124. There are seven kinds of consciousness with the formation of demerit as condition: the five
unprofitable resultants beginning with eye-consciousness ((50)–(54)), one mind element (55),
vsm2.17:124.3:
according as it is said: “Because of unprofitable kamma having been performed and stored up, resultant
eye-consciousness has arisen … ear- … nose- … tongue- … body-consciousness has arisen” (Dhs §556),
vsm2.17:124.4: “resultant mind element” (Dhs §562), “resultant mind-consciousness element has arisen” (Dhs §564).
vsm2.17:125.1: 125. There are four kinds of immaterial resultant consciousness ((62)–(65)) with the formation of the imperturbable as condition,
vsm2.17:125.2:
according as it is said: “Owing to that same profitable kamma of the immaterial sphere having been performed,
stored up by the development of that same profitable immaterial jhāna, with the abandoning of bodily pleasure and pain … he
enters upon and dwells in the resultant fourth jhāna, which, with the complete surmounting of perceptions of material form …
vsm2.17:125.3:
is accompanied by the base consisting of boundless space” (Dhs §501), “accompanied by the base
consisting of boundless consciousness” (Dhs §502),
vsm2.17:125.4:
“accompanied by the base consisting of nothingness” (Dhs §503), “accompanied by the base
consisting of neither perception nor non-perception” (Dhs §504).
vsm2.17:126.1:
126. After knowing what kind of consciousness has what formations as its condition,
one should now understand how it occurs as follows.
vsm2.17:126.2:
(2) The Occurrence of Resultant Consciousness

Now, this resultant consciousness all occurs in two ways, namely, (a) in the course of an individual
existence (or continuity), and (b) at the rebirth-linking moment.
vsm2.17:126.3: Herein, there are the two fivefold consciousnesses ((34)–(38) and (50)–(54)), two mind elements ((39) and (55)),
vsm2.17:126.4:
and root-causeless mind-consciousness element accompanied by joy (40), that is, thirteen which occur
only in the course of an existence in the five-constituent kind of becoming.
vsm2.17:126.5:
The remaining nineteen occur in the three kinds of becoming,
either in the course of an existence or at rebirth-linking, as appropriate.
vsm2.17:127.1:
2. (a) In the Course of an Existence

127. Firstly, in one who has been reborn by means of either profitable-result or unprofitable
result: according as his faculties mature,
vsm2.17:127.2:
so the five profitable-resultant eye-, etc., consciousnesses occur accomplishing the respective functions of seeing,
hearing, smelling, tasting, and touching ((d)–(h)), contingent respectively upon a desirable or desirable-neutral
visible datum, etc., as object that has come into the focus of the eye, etc.,
vsm2.17:127.3: and having the sensitivity of the eye, etc., as material support.
vsm2.17:127.4:
And likewise the five unprofitable-resultant consciousnesses; the only difference being this,
that the visible data, etc., as object for these are undesirable or undesirable-neutral.
vsm2.17:127.5:
And these ten are invariable as to their door, object, physical basis, and position in the cognitive
series, and invariable as to their functions.
vsm2.17:128.1: 128. After that, next to the profitable-resultant eye-, etc., consciousness, the profitable-resultant mind element (39) occurs
vsm2.17:128.2:
accomplishing the function of receiving (i), contingent upon the same object
as that of the former, and having the heart-basis as support.
vsm2.17:128.3: And next after the unprofitable-resultant eye-, etc., consciousness, the unprofitable-resultant mind element (55) occurs likewise.
vsm2.17:128.4:
But these two, while variable as to door and object, are invariable as to physical
basis and position, and invariable as to function.
vsm2.17:129.1:
129. Then next to the profitable-resultant mind element, the root-causeless mind-consciousness element
accompanied by joy (40) occurs accomplishing the function of investigation (j), contingent upon the same
object as that of the mind element, and having the heart-basis as support.
vsm2.17:129.2:
And when the object is a vivid one in any of the six doors belonging to sense-sphere beings, usually at the end of impulsions
associated with greed it holds up the renewal of the course of the life-continuum (b)
vsm2.17:129.3:
by occurring either once or twice as registration (m), having the same object
as that apprehended by the impulsions—so it is said in the Majjhima Commentary.
vsm2.17:129.4: But in the Abhidhamma Commentary two turns of consciousness have been handed down with respect to registration.
vsm2.17:129.5:
This consciousness has two names, “registration” (tad-ārammaṇa—lit. having that object that the preceding
impulsions had) and “aftermath life-continuum” (piṭṭhi- bhavaṅga—see XIV.122).
vsm2.17:129.6: It is variable as to door and object, it is invariable as to physical basis, and it is variable as to position and function.
vsm2.17:129.7:
This, in the first place, it should be understood, is how thirteen kinds of consciousness occur
only in the course of an individual existence in the five-constituent kind of becoming.
vsm2.17:130.1:
130. As to the remaining nineteen ((41)–(49) and (56)–(65)), there is none that does
not occur as a rebirth-linking (a) appropriate to it (see §133).
vsm2.17:130.2:
But in the course of an individual existence, firstly, two, namely, profitable-resultant and unprofitable-resultant
root-causeless mind-consciousness elements ((41) and (56)) occur accomplishing four functions,
vsm2.17:130.3:
that is to say, the function of investigating in the five doors (j) next after profitable-resultant and unprofitable-resultant
mind element, the function of registration (m) in the six doors in the way already stated,
vsm2.17:130.4:
the function of life-continuum (b) that continues after rebirth-linking given by themselves, as long as there is no thought-arising
to interrupt the life-continuum, and lastly the function of death (n) at the end of the course of an existence.
vsm2.17:130.5: And so these two are invariable as to possession of heart- basis, and variable as to door, object, position, and function.
vsm2.17:131.1:
131. The eight sense-sphere consciousnesses with root-cause ((42)–(49)) occur accomplishing three functions,
namely, the function of registration (m) in the six doors in the way already stated,
vsm2.17:131.2:
the function of life-continuum (b) after rebirth-linking given by themselves, as long as there
is no thought-arising to interrupt the life-continuum, and lastly the function of death (n) at the end.
vsm2.17:131.3: And they are invariable as to possession of heart- basis, and variable as to door, position, and function.
vsm2.17:132.1:
132. The five fine-material consciousnesses ((57)–(61)) and the four immaterial consciousnesses ((62)–(65)) occur
accomplishing two functions, namely, the function of life-continuum (b) that continues after rebirth-linking
given by themselves, as long as there is no thought-arising to interrupt the life-continuum,
vsm2.17:132.2: and the function of death (n) at the end.
vsm2.17:132.3:
As regards these, those of the fine-material sphere are invariable as to possession of heart-basis and as to their object, and they
are variable as to position and function, while the others occur invariably without heart-
basis, and they are invariable as to object, and variable as to position and function.
vsm2.17:132.4:
This, in the first place, is how the thirty-twofold resultant consciousness
occurs in the course of an individual existence with formations as condition.
vsm2.17:132.5:
And there in the course of an existence these several formations are conditions, as kamma
condition and decisive-support condition, for this thirty-twofold resultant consciousness.
vsm2.17:133.1:
2. (b) At Rebirth-Linking

133. But what was said above, namely, “as to the remaining nineteen, there is none
that does not occur as a rebirth-linking appropriate to it” (§130),
vsm2.17:133.2: is hard to understand since it is too brief.
vsm2.17:133.3:
Hence, in order to show the details it may be asked: (i) How many kinds of rebirth-linking are there?
(ii) How many kinds of rebirth-linking consciousness?
vsm2.17:133.4: (iii) Where and by what means does rebirth-linking come about? (iv) What does rebirth-linking consciousness have as its object?
vsm2.17:134.1: 134. (i) Including the rebirth-linking of non-percipient beings there are twenty kinds of rebirth-linking.
vsm2.17:134.2: (ii) There are nineteen kinds of rebirth-linking consciousnesses, as already described.
vsm2.17:134.3:
(iii) Herein, rebirth-linking by means of the unprofitable-resultant root- causeless
mind-consciousness element (56) comes about in the states of loss.
vsm2.17:134.4:
Rebirth-linking by means of the profitable-resultant (41) comes about in the human world among those blind from birth,
born deaf, born mad, born drivelling (see M I 20; M-a I 118), the sexless, and so on.
vsm2.17:134.5:
Rebirth-linking by means of the eight principal resultant consciousnesses with root-cause ((42)–(49))
comes about among deities of the sense sphere and the meritorious among men.
vsm2.17:134.6: That by means of the five fine-material resultant kinds comes about in the fine-material Brahmā-world.
vsm2.17:134.7: That by means of the four immaterial-sphere resultant kinds comes about in the immaterial world.
vsm2.17:134.8: So rebirth-linking consciousness conforms to the means by which, and the place in which, it comes about.
vsm2.17:134.9:
(iv) Briefly, rebirth-linking consciousness has three kinds of objects, namely, past,
present, and not-so-classifiable (see Ch. III, n. 32).
vsm2.17:134.10: Non-percipient rebirth-linking consciousness has no object.
vsm2.17:135.1:
135. Herein, in the base consisting of boundless consciousness and the base consisting of neither
perception nor non-perception, the object of rebirth-linking is past.
vsm2.17:135.2: That of the ten kinds of sense-sphere rebirth-linking is past or present.
vsm2.17:135.3: That of the rest is not-so-classifiable.
vsm2.17:135.4:
But while the rebirth-linking consciousness occurs thus with three kinds of objects, the death consciousness,
next to which it occurs, has only a past or a not-so-classifiable object,
vsm2.17:135.5: there being no death consciousness with a present object.
vsm2.17:135.6:
Consequently, it should be understood how it occurs in the happy destinies and the unhappy destinies
as follows, that is to say, how rebirth-linking consciousness with one of three kinds of objects
occurs next to death consciousness with one of two kinds of objects.
vsm2.17:136.1:
From happy to unhappy destiny.

136. For example, firstly in the case of a person in the happy destinies of the sense-sphere who is an evildoer, for it is said,
“Then the evil deeds that he did in the past … cover him and overspread him and envelop him” (M III 164), and so on.
vsm2.17:136.2: when he is lying on his deathbed, his evil kamma according as it has been stored up, or its sign, comes into focus in the mind door.
vsm2.17:136.3: Then next to the cognitive series of impulsions ending in registration that arose contingent upon that kamma or its sign,
vsm2.17:136.4: death consciousness arises making the life-continuum’s objective field its object.
vsm2.17:136.5: When it has ceased, rebirth-linking consciousness arises contingent upon that same kamma or kamma sign that had come into focus,
vsm2.17:136.6: and it does so located in the unhappy destiny, being driven there by the force of defilements that have not been cut off.
vsm2.17:136.7: This is the kind of rebirth-linking that has a past object and comes next to death consciousness with a past object.
vsm2.17:137.1: 137. In another’s case, owing to kamma of the kind already described,
vsm2.17:137.2:
there comes into focus at the mind door at the time of death the sign of the unhappy
destinies with the appearance of fire and flames, etc., in the hells, and so on.
vsm2.17:137.3:
So when the life-continuum has twice arisen and ceased, three sorts of cognitive-series
consciousness arise contingent upon that object, namely, the one adverting,
vsm2.17:137.4: impulsions numbering five because of the slowing down due to the nearness of death, and two registrations.
vsm2.17:137.5: After that, one death consciousness arises making the life-continuum’s objective field its object.
vsm2.17:137.6: At this point eleven consciousnesses have elapsed.
vsm2.17:137.7:
Then, having that same object, which has a life span of the remaining five conscious
moments, his rebirth-linking consciousness arises.
vsm2.17:137.8: This is the kind of rebirth-linking that has a present object and comes next to death with a past object.
vsm2.17:138.1:
138. In another’s case, at the time of death there comes into focus in one of the five
doors an inferior object that is a cause of greed, and so on.
vsm2.17:138.2:
When a series of consciousnesses up to determining have arisen in due succession, there arise impulsions
numbering five because of slowing down due to the nearness of death, and two registrations.
vsm2.17:138.3: After that, one death consciousness arises making the life-continuum’s objective field its object.
vsm2.17:138.4:
At this point fifteen consciousnesses have elapsed, namely, two life-continuums,
one each adverting, seeing, receiving, investigating and determining,
vsm2.17:138.5: five impulsions, two registrations, and one death consciousness.
vsm2.17:138.6:
Then, having that same object, which has a life span of the remaining one conscious moment,
his rebirth-linking consciousness arises.
vsm2.17:138.7: This also is the kind of rebirth-linking that has a present object and comes next to a death consciousness with a past object.
vsm2.17:138.8:
This, firstly, is how rebirth-linking in an unhappy destiny with past and present objects
occurs next to death consciousness in a happy destiny with a past object.
vsm2.17:139.1:
From unhappy to happy destiny.

139. In the case of one in an unhappy destiny who has stored up blameless kamma all should
be understood in the same way, substituting the bright for the dark side thus:
vsm2.17:139.2:
His good kamma, according as it has been stored up, or its sign, comes into focus in the mind
door and continuing in the way already stated.
vsm2.17:139.3:
This is how rebirth-linking occurs in a happy destiny with past and present objects
next to death consciousness in an unhappy destiny with a past object.
